name: Fjordur
summary: Fjordur is a free, official, and non-canonical DLC expansion map for |-| Asgard= |-| Jotunheim= |-| Vanaheim= === Unique Environmental Features === * Four primary islands within the mainland of Midgard- Vardiland, Vannaland, Bolbjord & Balheimr- feature frigid, towering forests and breathtaking landscapes to traverse. * Unique runic styled Obelisks and Supply Drops. * A low gravity Space zone featuring vibrant plant life, chargepets and stars, accessed through a glowing tunnel off the coast of Balheimr. * The most frequently spawning Alpha variants of any map * Deathworm Corpses on Balheimr that can be harvested for Deathworm Horns. * Rocks flowing with Honey can be found around the map, as well as rocks from which Nameless Venom can be harvested in caves * A tribute cave - found in Midgard, dedicated to those who supported the development during its roots as a modmap. * Various castles and ruins, scattered throughout the realms. * Mystical realms of Jotunheim, Vanaheim, and Asgard. ** All of the realms are accessible via The Hidden Worlds cave in Vannaland, or alternatively on official PvE servers, singleplayer mode, and servers with the UseFjordurTraversalBuff setting enabled, by holding |-| Vardiland= |-| Balheimr= |-| Asgard= |-| Jotunheim= |-| Vanaheim= |-| Other=
